Professional.name: Professional
Professional.description: Having the qualities that you connect with trained and skilled people, such as effectiveness, skill, organization, and seriousness of manner

Savvy.name: Savvy
Savvy.description: Shrewd and knowledgeable; having common sense and good judgment

Strange.name: Strange
Strange.description: Unusual or surprising in a way that is unsettling or hard to understand

Subtle.name: Subtle
Subtle.description: Making use of clever and indirect methods to achieve something

Ambitious.name: Ambitious
Ambitious.description: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed
